summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around second-order beneficiaries of tariff regimes, domestic-content rules, forced-labor checks, export controls, customs complexity, and supply-chain visibility mandates. The underfollowed lane is stronger in logistics/compliance software and consulting than in pure-play public TIC, because many TIC leaders are non-U.S.-listed or large. Best-fit U.S.-listed candidates for further work are Descartes Systems Group, UL Solutions, Expeditors, and ICF International. None are recommendations; all require Layer 2 evidence checks for revenue sensitivity to tariff/regulatory change.
